content.title: Site Development Permit
content.summary: A Site Development Permit is required for most land disturbing activities that change the existing soil cover or topography, including cuts, fills, earthwork construction, and site improvements that add impervious surfaces. Certain minor activities and specific exceptions do not require this permit.

steps.title: Determine if a Site Development Permit is Required
steps.text: You need a site development permit for any land disturbing activity that results in a change in the existing soil cover, both vegetative and nonvegetative, and/or the existing soil topography. Land disturbing activity does not include tilling conducted as part of agricultural practices, landscape maintenance, or gardening. You do not need a permit for certain minor activities as specified.

steps.title: Prepare Application Materials
steps.text: Prepare a completed site development permit application, plans, drainage report, site erosion control requirements plan, tree protection plan, and if applicable, a construction mitigation plan. Refer to the Site Development Permit Application Including Submittal Checklist for details.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.text: Submit your complete site development permit application including all required plans, supporting documents, and fees through the City of Woodinville's online permit portal.

required_documents.name: Site Development Permit Application
required_documents.description: Completed application form including submittal checklist.

required_documents.name: Plans
required_documents.description: Site plans showing the proposed development and land disturbing activities.

required_documents.name: Drainage Report
required_documents.description: Report detailing drainage plans for the site.

required_documents.name: Site Erosion Control Requirements Plan
required_documents.description: Plan showing measures to control erosion during construction.

required_documents.name: Tree Protection Plan
required_documents.description: Plan showing how existing trees will be protected during development.

required_documents.name: Construction Mitigation Plan
required_documents.description: Plan required in some cases to mitigate construction impacts.
